Visuals._comment_showBlockPreviews: Show previews of the blocks while placing them. Disable for better performance on low-end systems. Default: true
Visuals._comment_onlyShowBlockPreviewsWhenBuildi: Show block previews only when actively using a build mode. Reduces visual clutter when not building. Default: true
Visuals._comment_showMiniBlockPreview: Show a small transparent block inside each preview to highlight block rotation. Disable if you prefer the classic outline-only preview or want to reduce on-screen effects. Default: true
Visuals._comment_maxBlockPreviews: Don't show individual block previews when placing more than this many blocks. The outline will always be rendered regardless of this setting. Lower values improve performance for large builds. Range: 0 ~ 100000. Default: 4096
Visuals._comment_appearAnimationLength: How long it takes for a block to appear when placed in ticks. Set to 0 to disable animation for better performance. 20 ticks = 1 second Range: 0 ~ 100. Default: 5
Visuals._comment_breakAnimationLength: How long the break animation is in ticks. Set to 0 to disable animation for better performance. 20 ticks = 1 second Range: 0 ~ 100. Default: 10
Visuals._comment_previewScale: The scale of the ghost block previews. 1.0 is full size, 0.5 is half size, etc. Smaller values reduce visual clutter. Range: 0.05 ~ 1.0. Default: 0.25

Performance._comment: Performance settings for Sophisticated Building. Adjust these if experiencing lag or frame drops.
Performance._comment_previewRenderDistance: Maximum distance in blocks to render block previews. Blocks beyond this distance won't show individual previews. Lower values improve performance for large builds. Range: 16 ~ 256. Default: 64
Performance._comment_enableUpdateThrottling: Enable update throttling to reduce CPU usage when idle. When enabled, calculations are skipped if the player hasn't moved. Disable if experiencing issues with preview updates. Default: true
Performance._comment_maxMiniBlockPreviews: Maximum number of mini block previews to render. Mini previews show block rotation inside the ghost outline. Set to 0 to always show mini previews regardless of count (no limit). Range: 0 ~ 100000. Default: 4096
